hooks.name: Rebuild and restart wind-map container
hooks.description: After every agentic task, rebuilds the Docker image and restarts the container so the running app always reflects the latest code changes.

action.command: cd /Users/fredames/Projects/wind-map && docker build -t wind-map . && docker stop wind-map 2>/dev/null; docker rm wind-map 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name wind-map -p 5005:5005 -v wind_data:/app/data wind-map
